issue.message:
Library lint checks reference invalid APIs; these checks **will be skipped**!
Lint found an issue registry (`androidx.lifecycle.lint.LifecycleRuntimeIssueRegistry`) which contains some references to invalid API: org.jetbrains.kotlin.asJava.elements.KtLightModifierList#getKotlinOrigin(): org.jetbrains.kotlin.psi.KtModifierList (Referenced from androidx/lifecycle/lint/LifecycleWhenChecksKt.class)
Therefore, this lint check library is **not** included in analysis. This affects the following lint checks: `UnsafeLifecycleWhenUsage`,`RepeatOnLifecycleWrongUsage`
To use this lint check, upgrade to a more recent version of the library.
